note: All capabilities are unverified until the human runs the capture script and approves evidence. Do not mark any capability verified without real capture evidence.

capabilities.description: Clan profile: name, tag, badge, description, member count, war league, war frequency, war wins/losses/draws, location, labels, capital hall level, clan level, points.
capabilities.recoverabilityAfterMissedSync: current state only; historical snapshots depend on capture frequency
capabilities.fallbackDetail: Clan cannot be tracked without this endpoint.

capabilities.description: Paginated member list with tag, name, role, expLevel, league, trophies, versusTrophies, clanRank, previousClanRank, donations, donationsReceived, townHallLevel, playerHouse.
capabilities.recoverabilityAfterMissedSync: not recoverable; join/leave events between syncs are lost
capabilities.fallbackDetail: Member tracking is impossible without this endpoint. The Phase 1 vertical slice depends on this capability reaching at least field_observed.
capabilities.partialAcceptanceNote: Individual member records failing Zod validation may be stored as partial if the top-level list is valid JSON with required fields.

capabilities.description: Current war details: state (preparation, inWar, warEnded, notInWar), clan, opponent, startTime, endTime, teamSize, attacksPerMember, members with attacks (attacker, defender, stars, destructionPercentage, order, duration).
capabilities.availabilityWindow: available while war is active and briefly after; exact retention window unverified
capabilities.recoverabilityAfterMissedSync: partial — war summary may survive; attack detail may not once war ends
capabilities.fallbackDetail: War summary (result, size, opponent) may be available from war log. Attack detail and order show Unknown if not captured while active.

capabilities.description: Per-attack order field within the current war response. Required for pre-cleared mirror rule and watch-flag calculation.
capabilities.recoverabilityAfterMissedSync: not recoverable after war ends if not captured
capabilities.fallbackDetail: If order field is absent: pre-cleared mirror waiver shows Unknown; watch flag shows Unknown. Never invent order from other fields.

capabilities.description: Clan war log: list of past wars with opponent, result, teamSize, destructionPercentage, stars. May be private (403).
capabilities.availabilityWindow: unknown — number of past wars retained unverified; private war log returns 403
capabilities.recoverabilityAfterMissedSync: summary level only; detailed attacks not included
capabilities.fallbackDetail: Private war log returns 403. Show 'war log is private' in UI. Log may not include detailed attack records — those require currentwar capture during active war.
capabilities.partialAcceptanceNote: Individual war entries failing validation may be skipped with a warning.

capabilities.description: CWL league group for the current season: season ID, clans, rounds (warTags). Only available during active CWL season.
capabilities.availabilityWindow: current CWL season only; unavailable between seasons
capabilities.recoverabilityAfterMissedSync: season roster recoverable during season; round warTags needed to fetch each round
capabilities.fallbackDetail: Endpoint returns 404 outside CWL season. Show 'no active CWL season'. Records not captured show 'not captured'.

capabilities.description: Individual CWL round war with full attack detail. warTag obtained from cwl-league-group rounds. Detail availability has a limited retention window.
capabilities.availabilityWindow: limited; round detail may expire after CWL season ends — exact window unverified
capabilities.recoverabilityAfterMissedSync: not recoverable once retention window passes
capabilities.fallbackDetail: Rounds not captured during their availability window show 'not captured'. Missed rounds are labelled not_recovered, not failed.

capabilities.description: Capital raid season history: raids, members with attackCount, capitalResourcesLooted, attacks per member. District attack detail depends on sub-fields.
capabilities.recoverabilityAfterMissedSync: historical seasons may be recoverable; current active raid state depends on sync during weekend
capabilities.fallbackDetail: Missing or absent raid data shows Unknown with reason. Attack limits show Unknown if field not returned.
capabilities.partialAcceptanceNote: Individual season records failing validation may be skipped with warning.

capabilities.description: Per-member raid attack limit and bonus attack limit fields. Required to calculate expected attacks and identify missed attacks. Exact field names and semantics must be verified against real captures.
capabilities.fallbackDetail: If fields are absent or contradictory: expected attacks shows Unknown. Never assume a fixed limit or infer from clan-level totals.

capabilities.description: Whether per-member raid attacks are ordered across districts, enabling skipped-clear confirmation. Field name and presence unverified.
capabilities.fallbackDetail: If per-attack order is not exposed: skipped clears show 'possible' or Unknown, never 'confirmed'. Do not infer from district final state alone.

capabilities.description: Full player profile: tag, name, expLevel, trophies, versusTrophies, bestTrophies, warStars, attackWins, defenseWins, league, clan, role, donations, donationsReceived, achievements, troops, heroes, heroEquipment, spells.
capabilities.recoverabilityAfterMissedSync: not recoverable; progression timeline built from repeated snapshot captures
capabilities.fallbackDetail: Profile shows fields available from member snapshot when full player profile unavailable.
capabilities.partialAcceptanceNote: Missing optional fields produce Unknown in the UI; required fields missing causes the record to be rejected.

capabilities.description: Hero equipment field in the player profile. Field name and structure must be verified against the official schema.
capabilities.fallbackDetail: If heroEquipment field absent or not in official schema: feature disabled. An ordinary troop record is never proof of an active super troop.

capabilities.endpoint: GET /players/{playerTag} (field: troops with isActive or superTroopIsActive equivalent)
capabilities.description: Whether active super troops are exposed as a verifiable field, distinct from regular troop presence.
capabilities.fallbackDetail: If no distinct active-super-troop field: feature disabled. An ordinary troop record is never proof of an active super troop.

capabilities.description: Whether war opt-in/opt-out preference is returned in the player profile endpoint.
capabilities.fallbackDetail: If field absent: war preference display disabled. Shown only if the field is verified in Phase 0, with its observation time.

capabilities.description: Whether the 'Games Champion' achievement counter can be used to derive per-player Clan Games event points by diffing start and end snapshots. The diff approach is acceptable only if Phase 0 captures demonstrate the counter increases as expected including per-player cap and completed-achievement behaviour.
capabilities.availabilityWindow: cumulative counter; snapshot diffs only during active Clan Games
capabilities.recoverabilityAfterMissedSync: requires both a start snapshot and end snapshot during the Clan Games event
capabilities.fallbackDetail: If not verified: automatic member points disabled; manual entry only (event, player, score, source, timestamp, audit history). Clan Games endpoint does not exist in the official API.

capabilities.description: Tag lookup and normalisation verification: tags are uppercase, leading #, O→0 substituted, URL-encoded as %23. Verify the API normalises or rejects malformed tags.
capabilities.fallbackDetail: Tag normalisation logic is implemented in the app; API behaviour under malformed tags verified in Phase 0.
